title: Mosslight
tagline: A mischievous forest scavenger, six connected environments, and a sleeping jungle heart to restart.
stateNote: A Three.js platform adventure you can play in the browser, on phone or desktop.
problem: Platformers are usually about getting from A to B. Mosslight is about a small, curious character waking a forgotten world, with creatures you can ride and a journey from the Emerald Wilds to the Heart of the Wild.
audience: People who like cozy, atmospheric platformers, and anyone curious what a browser can render.
contribution: It is my project: an original, self-contained Three.js game with its own world, characters and music.
worksToday: Move, jump, roll, ride nearby creatures and use their abilities, per the README.
Touch controls appear automatically on touch devices.
Checkpoints and collectibles save locally in your browser.
limitations: I checked that the title screen loads and renders, not the full journey.
Sound is off until you turn it on.
